sizing.calculation_limits: DC bounds exclude ripple, transient excursion and PCB drop. Capacitance includes 20% design allowance, not a manufacturer minimum guarantee. Soft start uses the TI reference-charge model; SSC deviation and tracking gain/offset are typical. Validate waveforms on hardware.

inductor.analysis_min_basis: 20% initial tolerance plus10% allowance for operating-point change; verify the effective inductance at actual bias/frequency/temperature. This is an engineering floor, not a TDK guarantee.
inductor.dynamic_limit_basis: TI equation5 with typical50ns propagation delay; not a guaranteed maximum. Fault/thermal tests required.

open_work: Capture U11 controller including POW_EXT_SWR, supply bypass, clock/configuration, PCIe and magnetics. U13 remains disabled until that source is connected.
Complete hardware reset/ISOLATEB sequencing: stable rails plus>=100ms reset delay, REFCLK timing and>=50ms off/on interval; inspect Realtek TPERSTB-RTD10ms definition.

Finish system input supervision and PMIC brownout re-arm; source5V must remain within this design envelope. Discharge requires input typically>=2V and prior enable; do not assume arbitrary power loss leaves outputs discharged.
Close actual power budget, input/output capacitance totals, thermal placement and current limits after all loads are connected. X5R local temperature must stay<=85C.

Reserve at least5mV for core DC-plane drop and validate total ripple/transient excursion against remaining~17mV margin. Measure worst-case ramp monotonicity, startup overshoot, load transients and short-circuit recovery.
Frequency SSC increment, tracking gain/offset and inductor/capacitance curves have typical values; calculations size parts but do not replace prototype waveform and thermal tests.
Check final footprint copper/paste Gerbers, assembly orientation, solderability and mechanical clearance on the integrated board.
